Du siehst einen alten Trade ohne Ergebni: You see an old trade without its result and decide: take it or skip it. Right means taking winners and skipping losers.
Chart vor dem Einstieg ansehen: Look at the chart before entry
Noch kein Trade mit „Screenshot vor Entr: No trade with “Screenshot before entry” yet. Upload it in the trade view, then you can practise here.
Falsch eingeschätzte Trades kommen öfter: Trades you judged wrong come back more often. A trade is “mastered” once you have judged it right three times in a row.
Bei welchem Setup liegst du richtig?: Which setup do you read best?
Bei allen Setups liegst du gleich oft ri: You are right equally often with every setup.
Ab drei Trades je Setup siehst du hier,: From three trades per setup you'll see here where you are best.
Ab je drei Trades mit „Unsicher“ und „Si: Once you have three trades each with “Unsure” and “Sure”, you'll see here whether your feeling is right.
Wenn du dir sicher bist, liegst du öfter: When you are sure, you are right more often.
Wenn du dir sicher bist, liegst du selte: When you are sure, you are right less often.
Ob du dir sicher bist oder nicht, macht: Whether you feel sure or not makes hardly any difference for you.
Wie oft du richtig lagst, je nachdem wie: How often you were right, depending on how sure you were before deciding.
Ab zwei Runden siehst du hier, ob du bes: From two rounds on you'll see here whether you are improving.
Share correct per round, oldest on the left. Green: more than half right.
